description: In response to the accelerating labour displacement wave, the European Labour Council — long dormant — is reactivated by social partners and begins coordinating emergency AI transition protocols across member states. It brokers a temporary agreement between tech firms and unions to fund AI-displaced worker cooperatives in green infrastructure and care sectors, using partial liability waivers as incentive. The move stabilizes sentiment in key regions and creates a new institutional channel for managing AI-driven economic change, independent of Commission-led tech sovereignty efforts.
